_comment: MANUAL DATA FILE — the single source of truth for the languages this system accepts, and for whether AI translation is enabled for each. Edit it by hand; no code path writes, enables or approves anything here (Phase 6 Stage 5, decisions D3/D4/D9). Adding a language is a data change plus the steps in docs/ADDING_A_LANGUAGE.md — and a NEW language must start with translation_enabled=false until the owner records evidence and enables it. See app/core/LanguageRegistry.php (server reader) and src/lib/languageRegistry.js (client holder).

_fields.label: the plain-words name an officer reads in the selector
_fields.short: the compact name for printed lines, so it does not read 'Bisaya (Cebuano) (not translated)'
_fields.provider_label: how the language is DESCRIBED to the model in the per-call SOURCE LANGUAGE line
_fields.native_gloss: whether the gloss pair includes sourceGloss in this language (Bisaya/Tagalog do; mixed/other return it empty)
_fields.glossary_supported: whether the bilingual terminology table may carry entries in this language
_fields.translation_enabled: whether AI GENERATE may translate a source in this language; Tighten is governed separately
_fields.evidence: recorded by the OWNER when a bilingual reviewer has passed an evaluation run — never by code

languages.label: English
languages._note: English is never a SOURCE: there is nothing to translate into English. It is listed so the selector and the allowlist have one source.

languages.label: Bisaya (Cebuano)
languages._note: Enabled by the owner's Stage 3 decision (the feature shipped with Bisaya and Tagalog translatable). The evidence fields are EMPTY until the G4 bilingual review of docs/phase6-stage3-eval-review-sheet.md is recorded here — enablement and evidence are separate facts.

languages.label: Tagalog
languages._note: As ceb: enabled by the Stage 3 decision, evidence pending the G4 review.

languages.label: Mixed
languages.provider_label: a mix of Bisaya and/or Tagalog and English
languages._note: Translatable, with an EMPTY sourceGloss (the source has no single language). Unchanged from Stage 3.

languages.label: Other
languages._note: Translatable, with an EMPTY sourceGloss. Unchanged from Stage 3.
